info.description: Section 02 — the same copy as a statement section, but with two photographs set on a diagonal with a drawn connector between them. ⚠ The diagonal, the connector and the parallax are design and stay in the page; only the two photographs and their descriptions are here.

headingEm.description: The second line of the heading, set in italic. The page puts the line break in.

quoteAuthor.description: Leave empty to credit the Principal named in Site Settings.

imageUpperAlt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.
